details.metric_about: TUI parent peak RSS during the fixed open/review/history sequence

sampling.boundary: a kernel-accounted quantity of the session's process tree, not a wall latency: VmHWM, the concurrent tree sum, or utime+stime
sampling.cache_method: one fresh surface session per run on a 120-column, 40-row xterm-256color pseudo-terminal, driven with --reduced-updates through the fixed open/review/history sequence
sampling.order_rule: one recorded-seed coin flip per block decides baseline/candidate order

statistics.method: nearest-rank over MiB values; every counted run retained; the gate is the maximum sample against the ceiling

details.memory_definition: VmHWM of the surface parent process, read from /proc/<pid>/status after the fixed open/review/history sequence and before the quit key, in MiB (1 MiB = 1024 KiB); the value is the kernel's high-water mark, not a Margin report
notes: Quiet recheck; protocol and observed conditions: bench/results/raw/recheck-20261012T195920Z
every session drove the fixed sequence: the useful Read frame, the Changes view, the History view, back to Read, one j/k reading pair, then quit
